evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

rows.mappingNote: New curved-line article, including a drawn curve and graph curves.
rows.sourceNote: The stable verb comparison is 曲る, ordinarily written 曲がる; a straight line is a contrast, not a synonym.

rows.mappingNote: New article explicitly teaches discipline/order and the rules or regulations maintaining it.
rows.sourceNote: Retain the complete 紀律 spelling evidence; do not reduce 規律 to obedience only or equate every organizational rule with national legislation.

rows.mappingNote: New godan cutting-with-a-blade article; not a reuse of existing 切る or 着る.
rows.sourceNote: Qualify the raw behead/murder gloss by blade use: not every blade killing is beheading and not every killing uses a blade. Combined Daijisen 切る spellings do not freely share every sense.

rows.sourceNote: Raw singular pain is interpreted through the actual family pains/effort/trouble and Daijisen accomplishment definition, not silently taught as bodily pain.

rows.mappingNote: New waste/scrap article with usual kana writing and additional person-targeted insulting use.
rows.sourceNote: Material scraps can retain recycling value; the additional insult is not neutral. Missing 屑 kanji card does not remove the character from metadata.

rows.sourceNote: Avoid ambiguous English finger numbering and invented naming history; both primary components use native readings.

rows.mappingNote: New intransitive collapse/crumble article with additional lost shape, disordered state and deteriorating weather uses.
rows.sourceNote: Mark affected subject with が; intransitive does not mean causeless. No fixed severity partition from 荒れる or automatic transfer of all 崩す objects is asserted.

actualEntryInspections.headword: きる【切る／斬る／伐る／截る／剪る】
actualEntryInspections.location: Actual combined-entry raw HTML, approximately characters 49000-58500; blade-related definition 2a distinguished from other definitions.
actualEntryInspections.observation: A blade can injure or kill a person; the combined entry also covers other cutting uses and figurative criticism.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The combined spelling heading does not assign every cutting sense to 斬る. JMdict 1304400 separately supports killing with a blade and slicing/lopping/cutting off. Beheading is not required and arbitrary non-blade killing is not inferred.

actualEntryInspections.location: Actual raw-HTML body, approximately characters 49000-58500; not the earlier simplified footer.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Divide language by meaning, content or syllables, including pauses/punctuation; mark boundaries within an extent, including a curtain/room collocation.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Does not establish an unrestricted finish-anything verb. Raw stop/put-an-end-to wording is qualified through a marked stopping point or break. JMdict supplies the rare-spelling flag for 句切る; no frequency or historical reading derivation is inferred.

actualEntryInspections.location: Actual Japanese Daijisen body in raw HTML, approximately characters 72000-80500, definitions 1-2.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Cooling/air-cooling device and portable insulated cooler or icebox.
actualEntryInspections.limits: An earlier raw range contained an English cooler article in 実用日本語表現辞典, not this Japanese lexical evidence. Its refrigerator or cocktail senses are not transferred. Cooling emphasis does not prove every named device lacks heating.

actualEntryInspections.location: Actual raw-HTML body, approximately characters 49000-57500, definitions 1-2.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Dissatisfaction concerning disadvantage/harm caused by others and its expression; difficult circumstances are separately defined.
actualEntryInspections.limits: The historical quotation under the second definition alone does not establish an obsolete or measured-rare label. The practical complaint focus is not an unrestricted replacement for bodily pain or every personal worry.

actualEntryInspections.observation: Trying or thinking through ways to accomplish something; painstaking effort, including making and efforts-bearing-fruit collocations.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Not ordinary bodily pain. Lexical and collocation support is not independent attestation of the full original explanation/model sentences.

actualEntryInspections.location: Actual lexical body recovered by simplified fetch.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Destroy coherent form; disturb stable condition; relax, smile or write cursively in particular constructions; change larger money into equal-value smaller denominations; lower a price.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Daijisen numbering differs from JMdict. The note-changing collocation supports the selected monetary use, not arbitrary currency exchange or literal destruction of monetary value.

actualEntryInspections.location: Actual raw-HTML heading and body, approximately characters 50000-57500, definitions 1-2 and supplementary spelling distinction.
actualEntryInspections.observation: Standards/rules governing conduct and consistent order. The supplement associates ordinary 規律 with group/organizational order and 紀律 with moral discipline as a spelling tendency.
actualEntryInspections.limits: Both selected JMdict meanings are supported; 規律 is not reduced to obedience alone. Daijisen ordering is not JMdict sense numbering and spelling tendencies are not absolute semantic partitions.

quizGuardRationale: Direct exclusions are symmetric and nontransitive. Exact titles already deduplicate; actual labels and ordinary secondary senses matter. No baseline exclusion changes are introduced beyond the established batch-19 機械/道具 exception.
曲線 protects curved-line/curve/bend and broad line labels, not the contrasting straight-line category as a synonym. Stable ID 曲る retains its ordinary 曲がる spelling.

規律 protects rule/regulation/discipline and unqualified English order/rule labels. 約束 has an actual convention/rule sense; 整理 has regulation/organization in its complete family. Commands, domination, organizing things and maintaining discipline are not thereby identical Japanese uses.
斬る protects blade-cutting/killing and unqualified defeat/knock-down labels. 討つ concerns attack/defeat, not a guarantee of blade use. Homophone 着る is not a synonym.

気を付ける protects actual careful/attention/care labels and overlapping parting wishes. A shared safety topic does not automatically add prevention 予防; noticing and caregiving remain distinct in the text.

区域 protects area/district/section, area-extent/limits and boundary labels, including 場所's actual area sense. Entire regions and dividing edges are not automatically interchangeable in Japanese. Activity fields are not added by topic alone.
偶数 protects the broad number label, not the contrasting odd-number category. 薬指 similarly protects the broad finger/toe label, not neighboring digits merely by anatomy.
空想 protects imagination, dreams and imagined ideas, including imaginary 架空; it does not assert that all imagined things are asleep, impossible or medical delusions.
空中 protects sky/air labels despite the spatial/substance distinction. Outer space is not imported merely by topic.
クーラー protects actual air-cooling/air-conditioning overlap with 冷房. No 冷蔵庫 guard is inferred merely from shared cooling equipment or an English cooler article's refrigerator sense.
釘 protects ピン through actual nail-like pin coverage. Body nails, screws and every English pin device are not equated.
区切る protects division/separation and broad stop/end labels while qualifying the source-selected stopping-point use. Spatial boundaries and linguistic pauses remain positively taught.
くしゃみ and 櫛 have no topic-only cough/brush/skewer exclusions. Their articles explain the lexical distinctions; the restricted くさめ charm sense is not transferred.

苦情 protects actual complaints/grumbling/dissatisfaction and the source's difficult-circumstances/troubles labels. Supplemental complete families support がたがた, ぐずぐず and ぶうぶう, not just their sound meanings.

苦心 protects painstaking effort/labor and trouble-taking labels. 苦痛/痛み are not added merely from the raw singular pain gloss, because the selected lexical meaning is taking pains rather than bodily pain. 苦情 overlap is qualified through broad troubles, not an ordinary hard-work translation.
屑 protects waste/refuse, paper scraps and leftover/dregs labels without making every remainder worthless. The additional person-targeted meaning is explicitly insulting.

崩す/崩れる protect direct breaking/collapse and applicable denomination-changing labels. The complete 崩す family additionally supports smile and lowering-price guards; 崩れる supports monetary change and decline. These exclusions do not silently promote each unselected sense to N2 teaching.
崩れる additionally protects crumbling, disorder and deteriorating/rough weather labels. No fixed severity threshold, causelessness rule or transitive closure of guards is claimed.
sourceAccessLimits: Nineteen new articles and one scoped 金魚 reuse cover twenty rows. 金魚 gains only sourced jlpt 2; unchanged teaching is not recertified.
Five new primary-form reciprocal N2 pairs: 線/曲線, 律/規律, 区/区域, 域/区域 and 区/区切る. Existing カーブ gains only a link around its already present 曲線 comparison.

Missing primary component cards 斬, 釘, 櫛, 屑 and 崩 are not manufactured; the written characters remain in metadata. Missing 奇数, 直線 and other comparison articles remain plain text, not broken links or invented cards.
All baseline identities, primary readings, titles, written-kanji arrays, easier sourced levels and the established exclusion state remain preserved. No new baseline exclusions are changed.

Several simplified Weblio fetches returned irrelevant footer material. Only actual identified Japanese dictionary bodies count as lexical inspections; the English cooler article is not Japanese lexical verification.

Complete families retain unselected/historical/specialist uses, unrelated homophones and restrictions. Reading-restricted くさめ sense 2 does not belong to くしゃみ. Search-only forms are retained as lookup evidence, not promoted as ordinary spelling recommendations.
The community N2 list is not an official syllabus. Additional meanings are recorded explicitly but do not independently acquire an N2 assignment.

Inspection receipts document author access, not independent reviewer retrieval. Original examples are not corpus quotations, measured frequency claims, native-speaker certification or executed app draws.
On-first mixed-reading categories follow existing app conventions. Constituent associations are not proof of historical formation; no medicine-finger naming story is invented.
